ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; distal regions exhibit high-intensity white pixels (>220 intensity), while the proximal hub and medial streaks consist of low-intensity black pixels (<30 intensity) in approximately a 60:40 spatial ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity mass centrally located at the notch junction; high-frequency dark punctate clusters and mottling distributed across the distal white lobe fields, particularly on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped median notch with an interior angle of approximately 55 degrees; depth is vertically significant, terminating at the boundary of the central black hub.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration profile along the trailing edge with prominent macro-indentations and jagged peaks; distinct 'U' shaped secondary notches visible on the mid-right trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex lateral margins tapering to acute distal tips; right tip exhibits a unique inward-hooked trajectory relative to the left tip's more linear distal sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible cluster of circular dark-pixel aggregates on the distal right fluke white field, consistent with localized surface pitting.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single prominent curvilinear dark line (approx. 45-degree orientation) disrupting the white pigmentation on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple deep irregular indentations along the trailing edges; notable hooked deformity and jagged truncation at the distal right tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pigmentation asymmetry where the left lobe contains a larger, more continuous high-intensity white field than the right lobe.
